    ///
    /// **Rate-capped, NOT a timer.** Tool-use turns can arrive many per second;
    /// we coalesce them to at most one emit per [`PROGRESS_MIN_INTERVAL`] per
    /// session. Crucially the emit is driven by REAL forward motion: when the
